audit: SCOPE AUTHORITY seam - blind adversarial review
summary: Two save gates (validateGameSaveShape then assertSaveAcceptable/preflight) plus restore-time normalization guard persisted claims. The realm/foundation/technique/affix/tribulation seams are deeply coherent - they replay the authored writers' rules at the boundary. The gaps cluster in one class: progress LEVEL and currency-TIER claims that bound only against catalog ceilings (maxLevel, MAX_SLOT_ENHANCE_LEVEL, stackLimit), never against the realm-tier that every authored WRITER gates on. Five confirmed findings; the forged-claims mint real effects on restore (enhance scale x4.6, production level 9 on a mortal, trung/thuong stone spending, and a beyond-ceiling realm that plays at tier 4 behind a notice-only flag). 20+ attacked surfaces held.

findings.title: Forged high-tier spirit-stone stacks accepted at boundary and spent by enhance
findings.detail: Every spirit-stone writer is realm-tier-keyed (production rollRewards via collectionRealmId, vendor quoteStoneGrant, GameManagerRewardOps reward receiver via getRealmTier(player.realmId), tribulation penalties). Beta realms mortal/qi_refining/foundation_establishment are tiers 1/2/3, so spirit_stone_trung_pham (tier>=4) and spirit_stone_thuong_pham (tier>=7) have ZERO beta producers. validateStackEntries checks registry membership + amount>=0 only; spirit stones declare stackLimit MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. The forged stack restores verbatim and enhance() accepts it: at enhanceLevel 30 the required stone id is spirit_stone_trung_pham (getSpiritStoneMaterialIdForEnhanceLevel), hasSpiritStones passes, spend commits - the forge pays a cost tier no beta session can unlock.
findings.reproduction: mortal save + materials[{spirit_stone_trung_pham x5000}] + equipmentSlots[{weapon enhanceLevel 30}] -> validateGameSaveShape ok=true -> restoreGameSession ok -> stack lands 5000 -> equipmentSystem.enhance('weapon','mortal',...) returns reason != 'missing_spirit_stone' and the trung stack drops below 5000. Probe: F-A in scopeAuthorityBlind.qa.test.ts (both secure assertions fail: shape.ok expected false, got true).

findings.title: Forged equipmentSlots[].enhanceLevel restores verbatim and mints stat scale
findings.attack_class: forged persisted claim (progression level vs realm-tier-gated writer)
findings.detail: validateEquipmentSlotEntries bounds enhanceLevel to [0, MAX_SLOT_ENHANCE_LEVEL=100] only. The authored writer enhance() spends the spirit-stone tier keyed by level (ha_pham-only beta economy caps honest play at enhance <=29). A forged enhanceLevel 60 restores, and calculateEquipmentScale(level)=1+level*0.06 applies x4.6 to every stat of whatever item is equipped in the slot (EquipmentSystem :931, applied to equipped items at mint). No replay of the cost history bounds the claim to what the save's realm tier could have paid.
findings.reproduction: mortal save + equipmentSlots[{weapon, enhanceLevel 60, enhanceFailStreak 0}] -> shape ok -> restore ok -> equipmentSlotManager.get('weapon').enhanceLevel === 60 -> calculateEquipmentScale(60) === 4.6. Probe: F-B.

findings.title: Forged production-site and building levels mint impossible production (realm-tier gate skipped at boundary)
findings.attack_class: forged persisted claim (level vs realm-tier-gated writer)
findings.surface: productionSites[].level -> validateProductionSitesSave (:2715) -> ProductionSystem.restoreStates / buildings[].level -> validateBuildingsSave (:2580) -> getStoredAmount
findings.detail: Authored writers gate on realm tier: upgradeSite refuses currentRealmTier < targetLevel (level N+1 needs tier N+1); BuildingSystem.build canBuildDetailed gates requiredRealmId and upgrade refuses getRealmTier(currentRealmId) < instance.level+1. The save validators bound ONLY against catalog maxLevel (site.maxLevel / template.maxLevel) - no realm check. Restore copies level verbatim (restoreStates) and the level flows into live mints: spawned lanes stamp cycleMs = computeCycleSeconds(base, forged level)*1000 (level 9 = 4.6x speed, SITE_SPEED_MULTIPLIERS), and building accrual rate/capacity keys off the forged level.
findings.reproduction: mortal save + productionSites[{thanh_van_lam, level 9, autoRestart}] -> shape ok -> restore ok -> getState level 9 -> setWorkerAssignment spawns a lane with completesAt-startedAt == computeCycleSeconds(mortalBase, 9)*1000; control: upgradeSite on a clean level-1 save returns rejected (tier 1 < 2). Building variant: buildings[{linh_tuyen, level 9, accrualRealmId mortal}] -> shape ok -> getStoredAmount(9-level, T0+3600s) = 3300 vs 1269 for level 1 over the same window; control upgrade refused. Probe: F-C x2.

findings.title: Forged workerCycle.siteLevelAtStart mints a compressed settle window on a level-1 site
findings.attack_class: forged persisted claim (cycle window parameters vs parent state)
findings.detail: Per-cycle validation requires the span to equal computeCycleSeconds(CYCLE_BASE_SECONDS_BY_REALM[collectionRealmId], siteLevelAtStart)*1000, and pins collectionRealmId <= player realm - but siteLevelAtStart is bounded only by the site definition's maxLevel, NOT by the parent site entry's actual level and NOT by realm tier. A level-1 site can carry cycles stamped at level 9: the span is forged consistent so the validator passes, restore keeps the lane, and tickWorkers settles it immediately granting the cycle rewards. A lane claiming level 9 on a level-1 site is a state no writer emits (ensureSiteState stamps the site's real level).
findings.reproduction: mortal save + productionSites[{thanh_van_lam, level 1, workerCycles:[{siteLevelAtStart 9, completesAtMs T0+level9-span}] }] -> shape ok -> restore ok -> lane kept -> tickWorkers(T0+span) settles: material bag grows, lane list empties. Probe: F-D.

findings.title: Beyond-ceiling realm claim loads (flag is notice-only) and plays at the forged tier
findings.detail: A canonical golden_core save (coherent technique holder + sealed gradeHistory for the lagging grade, foundation record, realm index 4) passes shape validation and restores ok; unsupportedReleaseReason returns 'realm_beyond_release' which surfaces only a notice (useAppLifecycle :467). The forged realm is then LIVE: getRealmTier(golden_core)=4 keys the reward receiver (GameManagerRewardOps) and vendor quoteStoneGrant to spirit_stone_trung_pham - the impossible-currency of F-SCOPE-1 becomes legally produced; building/site upgrade realm-tier gates lift to 4; all beta stages/unlocks satisfy requiredRealmId <= golden_core. Note: flagged-load is the designed cross-release carry-forward path and the flag cannot distinguish a forged realm - the defect is that tier-keyed faucets do not bound by the flag, not that the save loads. resolveTerritoryTier does clamp production to foundation tier, so the production faucet stays ha_pham.
findings.reproduction: beyondCeilingSave('golden_core') -> validateGameSaveShape ok -> restoreGameSession status ok, player.realmId 'golden_core', unsupportedReleaseReason 'realm_beyond_release'. Probe: F-E.
